description: Create the deterministic Deep Ownership fixture for the Sibi pedagogy runtime loop.
preconditions: Spec pack exists under docs/specs/deep-ownership-workspace.
The repo has existing runtime files and tests for gap detection, readiness, practice, and memory.
expectedBehavior: A fixture describes one scoped loop over this repo.
The fixture includes boundary, concept slice, thinking artifact, user operation, sample attempt, evidence check, gap, repair action, and readiness claim.
Every evidence reference includes file path, line range or excerpt, and evidence role.
verificationSteps: Open the fixture and confirm it includes the required objects listed in 10_droid_execution_brief.md.
Confirm readiness is scoped to one operation and does not claim whole-repo ownership.
Confirm no evidence path is outside the declared boundary.

description: Build the local static Workspace prototype that renders the fixture.
preconditions: DOW-F-001 fixture exists.
The prototype can live under docs/specs/deep-ownership-workspace/prototypes/morning-workspace.
expectedBehavior: The prototype renders a left boundary rail, center artifact canvas, right Sibi loop panel, and bottom evidence panel.
The answer/final explanation remains hidden before an attempt.
The sample gap/readiness state is visible after the user triggers the sample attempt.
verificationSteps: Open the prototype locally.
Inspect desktop layout.
Confirm four workspace regions are visible.
Confirm answer-first content is gated.
Record a manual review note.

description: Add runtime types for DeepOwnershipLoop, ThinkingArtifact, UserOperation, EvidenceCheck, and WorkspaceSnapshot.
preconditions: Prototype fixture shape has stabilized enough to encode as TypeScript types.
Existing runtime-support.ts and runtime-study-panel.ts contracts have been reviewed.
expectedBehavior: Runtime types represent the fixture shape without UI-owned pedagogy logic.
WorkspaceSnapshot projects state for UI rendering.
Types preserve evidence roles and hidden solution boundaries.
verificationSteps: Run pnpm run typecheck.
Add or update focused runtime contract tests.
Confirm Swift UI contracts are not forced to own pedagogy.

description: Implement deterministic code-slice and flow-diagram thinking artifact generation for one bounded repo slice.
preconditions: DOW-F-003 runtime artifact types exist.
Artifact session and concept graph commands already produce bounded evidence.
expectedBehavior: The runtime can generate a code_slice artifact from included files.
The runtime can generate a flow_diagram artifact from concept graph and evidence.
Generated artifacts include operation kind, renderer payload, source evidence, and hidden solution references.
verificationSteps: Run focused artifact generation tests.
Confirm uncited artifact claims are rejected.
Confirm hidden solution fields are not included in pre-attempt UI projection.

description: Implement attempt capture and evidence check for one thinking artifact operation.
preconditions: DOW-F-003 runtime types exist.
DOW-F-004 produces at least one operation-bearing artifact.
expectedBehavior: The user can submit an attempt with answer text, confidence, selected evidence, and declared unknowns.
The runtime stores the attempt as evidence.
The runtime compares the attempt against required claims and evidence criteria.
verificationSteps: Run attempt capture tests.
Run partial, wrong, uncertain, and overconfident attempt cases.
Confirm the full answer remains gated before attempt.

description: Emit scoped readiness and concrete repair actions from the first evidence check.
preconditions: DOW-F-005 can produce EvidenceCheck results.
Existing gap detection, practice challenge, memory, and readiness code has been reviewed for reuse.
expectedBehavior: A gap-bearing attempt produces an OwnershipGap, concrete repair action, and scoped ReadinessClaim.
Readiness does not claim whole-repo mastery.
Repair asks the user to perform a concrete operation.
verificationSteps: Run focused gap/readiness tests.
Confirm every gap cites user and artifact evidence.
Confirm repair actions are not generic study advice.

description: Add study artifact output directory and guardrails that separate study mutation from product mutation.
preconditions: Generated artifacts need to be persisted outside product source files.
The project has an agreed local artifact directory convention.
expectedBehavior: Study artifacts are written only to the declared Sibi-owned directory.
Study artifacts cite the source evidence used to generate them.
Product source files are not modified.
verificationSteps: Run tests for output path guardrails.
Inspect git status after study artifact generation.
Confirm generated artifacts are marked study-only.

description: Add open-in-editor citation payloads for code ranges.
preconditions: The UI renders code slices with path and line references.
The core remains editor-independent.
expectedBehavior: Code citations include open-in-editor metadata.
The UI can render an Open in Editor action.
The feature does not require a VS Code extension.
verificationSteps: Inspect generated citation payload.
Manually open a file at line if local environment supports it.
Confirm the workspace still works without editor integration.

description: Prototype a Tauri shell for the Workspace after the static UI interaction is accepted.
preconditions: DOW-F-002 prototype has been reviewed and accepted.
The team decides to move beyond static web prototype.
expectedBehavior: The Workspace can open as a desktop app shell.
The shell renders the same fixture.
No product mutation or editor dependency is introduced.
verificationSteps: Run the Tauri dev app if scaffolded.
Verify fixture rendering.
Confirm filesystem access is bounded.

description: Connect the Swift Sibi Lens to the active WorkspaceSnapshot after runtime contracts exist.
preconditions: WorkspaceSnapshot runtime projection exists.
Existing Swift Study Panel model has been reviewed.
expectedBehavior: The Lens shows current goal, active operation, readiness/gap chip, and Open Workspace action.
Swift does not own pedagogy, memory, or readiness decisions.
The Lens remains a small prompt/command surface.
verificationSteps: Run Swift tests.
Render fixture snapshot.
Confirm no Swift-side pedagogy logic was added.

description: Convert the Sibi Lens + Lab UI iteration references into reusable Workspace prototype components.
preconditions: 12_ui_reference_components.md exists.
DOW-F-002 static Workspace prototype exists or is being created.
The relevant iteration images remain available under docs/iterations/sibi-ui-lab-lens.
expectedBehavior: The prototype names which reference component each rendered region implements.
Lens, code workbench, derivation ladder, patch readiness, and repo overview patterns can be reproduced from structured fixture data.
Each component preserves evidence visibility, gated answer state, and scoped readiness or next action.
verificationSteps: Open the UI prototype.
Compare each rendered component to its contract in 12_ui_reference_components.md.
Capture screenshots or a manual review note.
Confirm the UI does not become chat-first or a full IDE clone.
